# Establish project guidance — `workflow bootstrap [brief path]`

Read the supplied brief and inspect the project. Use existing guidance before creating more. If
there is no identifiable goal or input, ask for it; do not invent a product or commitments.

Create only documents needed for the current work. A short README and focused agent guidance may
suffice. Add PRODUCT.md for durable product direction, DESIGN.md for an actual design system, or
ROADMAP.md for agreed sequencing when each has useful content. No empty document suite or no-UI
stubs. Clearly distinguish desired behavior from implemented behavior.

Resolve genuinely consequential unknowns while completing independent setup. Preserve existing
files and the original brief. Do not archive, delete, or rewrite their authority automatically.
If project direction is contested, use a focused [direction check](direction-stress-tests.md).

Report what was established and recommend the first useful implementation action. Bootstrap does
not force the next task into brainstorming or create permission to push or publish.
